## Reference

Tang W, Yu Q, Crits-Christoph P, Tu XM. [A new analytic framework for moderation analysis: moving beyond analytic interactions](../references/pdfs/tang-2009-moderation.pdf). *Journal of Data Science*. 2009;7:313-329.

## Abstract
- Conceptually, a moderator is a variable that modifies the effect of a predictor on a response.
- Analytically, a common approach as used in most moderation analyses is to add analytic interactions involving the predictor and moderator in the form of cross-varaible products and test the significance of such terms.
